title: New domestic trials beyond general review

captions.energy: Reassessing whole routines instead of choosing

meaning: Your domestic support preserves freedom when a new trial allows a specific discussion of familiar comfort’s cost instead of replacing choice with assessment of all shared life.
text: You can try a domestic method while preserving familiar convenience. The Fool in the physical position of Muladhara appears through new experience without a permanent ready form. Judgement in energy can reassess the entire routine instead of choosing specifically. The Devil in emotions holds to familiar comfort. Simple change becomes harder: before determining what is useful now, both discuss what attachment says about the entire domestic path. Pleasure is defended as a whole system, while its cost disappears behind a general explanation of desire.

For example, you try freeing the sitting room from rarely used objects. One favourite armchair is wanted, and conversation evaluates the entire habit of comfort instead of its position and use. **Free choice benefits from a specific cost rather than a general conclusion about a person or routine.** Both can acknowledge pleasure and discuss workload. A trial requires neither everything retained nor readiness for different living proved by losing every familiar pleasant object.

The difficulty is seeking certainty through broad explanation instead of a manageable decision. Attachment strengthens under general assessment while beginning remains argument. Support grows when feeling, object and purpose are distinguished. Both can try the new without a final verdict on the past: understandable use gives grounds to choose continuation without making every convenience prove all shared domestic history correct.
